rationale: Build on the current staged reverse-tail recurrence curriculum by adding a learned per-tail-block anchor refresh gate. The recurrent tail no longer carries only against a frozen decoder-output anchor; it can progressively refresh that anchor before each reverse recurrence step. This is a compact structural change in the strongest local idea family, keeps shapes compile-stable, adds only small control tensors that survive export cleanly, and specifically targets the winning recurrent-tail/export path instead of spending the run on another scalar sweep.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
